description: This Java class 'ConceptNumeric' extends the 'Concept' class by adding numeric-specific properties such as range values, units, decimal allowances, and reference ranges. It is part of the OpenMRS API, modeling concepts that have numeric data types within a medical record system.

classes.name: ConceptNumeric
classes.description: A class representing a numeric concept in the OpenMRS data model, extending the base Concept class to include numeric ranges, units, precision, and reference ranges.

methods.name: getHiAbsolute
methods.description: Returns the absolute high limit value.

methods.name: setHiAbsolute
methods.description: Sets the absolute high limit value.

methods.name: getHiCritical
methods.description: Returns the critical high limit value.

methods.name: setHiCritical
methods.description: Sets the critical high limit value.

methods.name: getHiNormal
methods.description: Returns the normal high limit value.

methods.name: setHiNormal
methods.description: Sets the normal high limit value.

methods.name: getLowAbsolute
methods.description: Returns the absolute low limit value.

methods.name: setLowAbsolute
methods.description: Sets the absolute low limit value.

methods.name: getLowCritical
methods.description: Returns the critical low limit value.

methods.name: setLowCritical
methods.description: Sets the critical low limit value.

methods.name: getLowNormal
methods.description: Returns the normal low limit value.

methods.name: setLowNormal
methods.description: Sets the normal low limit value.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units associated with the numeric concept.

methods.name: setUnits
methods.description: Sets the units associated with the numeric concept.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Determines if the concept's datatype is 'Numeric', always true for numeric concepts.

methods.name: getDisplayPrecision
methods.description: Returns the number of significant digits used for display.

methods.name: setDisplayPrecision
methods.description: Sets the number of significant digits used for display.

methods.name: getAllowDecimal
methods.description: Returns whether decimals are allowed.

methods.name: setAllowDecimal
methods.description: Sets whether decimals are allowed.

methods.name: isAllowDecimal
methods.description: Deprecated method, use getAllowDecimal().

methods.name: getReferenceRanges
methods.description: Returns the set of reference ranges associated with the concept.

methods.name: setReferenceRanges
methods.description: Sets the reference ranges for the concept.

methods.name: addReferenceRange
methods.description: Adds a reference range to the concept.

methods.name: removeReferenceRange
methods.description: Removes a reference range from the concept.
